# setInfo() function

Reports a successful cache write and passes the value straight through, so it can be used inline in a return position. Logs only when [PG\_CACHE\_DEBUG](/api/pg-cache/latest/pg-cache.pg_cache_debug/) is on.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function setInfo(logger: ILogger, res: any, key: string, decorator: Function): any;
```
